policyReview.message: UMGC’s bachelor’s degree requirements set no degree-wide upper-level minimum. Their only upper-level rule is 15 upper-level credits (courses numbered 300 to 499) completed at UMGC. This plan’s named upper-level courses with no outside option total 6 of 15 credits, so meeting the rule depends on the student’s choices.
policyReview.question: Ask UMGC which upper-level (300–499) courses in this plan count toward the 15 upper-level credits it requires you to take at UMGC.
